author: Dylan Shaw
why: Photographer confirms a predawn view overlooking Everest and its Nepal base camp, with stars and a small human figure. Atmospheric alternative; native dimensions unverified.

author: Slava Auchynnikau
why: Source identifies Everest illuminated by golden sunrise light and locates the photograph in Nepal. Strong warm-colour option; exact viewpoint and native dimensions unverified.

author: Success Dhamala
why: Photographer confirms sunrise behind Everest from Kala Patthar, Nepal—the classic Nepal-side viewpoint. Native dimensions unverified.
